description: In WebKit (Safari engine) the board filter selects (Assigned to, Status filter, Vein) render as ~20px native pop-up buttons, while in Chromium they are 40px styled fields matching the tab buttons beside them.
expected: Filter selects have the same height and styling in Safari as in Chromium.
actual: Compact native selects in WebKit next to 40px buttons.
suggested_fix: Add `appearance: none` plus explicit height/padding and a custom chevron to the filter selects.

description: A different browser (WebKit with no stored state) opens the first project in registry order, and a stale last-project ID falls back to it silently. There is no URL or `client open --project` way to land on a chosen project.
expected: The URL encodes the project (or `pardner open --project`), so a launch can target a project.
actual: Always Checkout rewrite (first) without browser memory.
suggested_fix: Add a `?project=` URL parameter honoured after sign-in.
